conviction_note: Small long lean: management baselined H2 calculated current billings (CCB) at 7-8% straight after a 16% Q2, the closest peer (Tenable, 28 Oct) reported Q3 CCB speeding up to 9%, and the PHP2Shell disclosure (17 Oct) gives a Q4 demand story. Against that: the stock is +52% YTD at $202, above the $180.53 consensus target, the 25-delta skew is +7.6 vol points toward downside, it gained 6% today into the print, and Tenable's own beat-and-raise faded from $48.65 to $47.0. So p_up is only 53 on an abs move of 10.5 (option-implied 9.9%, last four reactions 13.8 / 1.4 / 13.3 / 20.6). The findings sum (+1.1) is larger than the scaled number (+0.63) because each finding is sized alone, while the scaled number carries the skew and the run-in once.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue $186.54M and non-GAAP EPS $1.95 consensus, with a whisper of $2.06 (Earnings Whispers, https://www.earningswhispers.com/stocks/qlys, read 2026-11-09). Company guide: revenue $185.5-187.5M, non-GAAP EPS $1.91-1.98, FY26 revenue $732-738M, FY26 EPS $7.74-7.88, and H2 CCB 'baselined' at 7-8% (Q2 8-K Ex. 99.1, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1107843/000110784326000034/qlys-20260804xex991.htm, and the call, https://www.webull.com/news/15386993117914112). The revenue consensus sits on the guide midpoint, so the revenue bar is sourced. There is no published Street number for CCB: the only billings bar is the company's 7-8% H2 baseline. Q3 2025 CCB was $186.4M (+11%), so 7-8% means about $199.5-201.3M (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1107843/000110784325000037/qlys-20251104xex991.htm). Billings findings are capped small because that bar is the company's own.
positioning_check: Short interest 3.23M shares at the 15 Oct 2026 settlement, 5.0 days to cover on about 653K average daily volume; 34.6M shares outstanding, so about 9.3% of shares (https://massive.com/quote/qlys, read 2026-11-09). Earlier: 3.28M and 4.9 days at 30 Sep, 3.7M and 5.1 days at 19 Aug. Elevated but not a crowded squeeze (below the 18-23% cases in LESSONS). Options (sealed baseline): event-implied move 9.91%, 25-delta skew +7.62 vol points (downside paid), put/call OI 1.19, ATM IV 92.7%, ATM spread 14% of mid, total OI only 1,329, so the chain is thin. Tape: 52-week range $74.51-$235.55, YTD +51.8%, +6.1% intraday today ($190.41 to about $202), -5.3% on 5 Nov. Sell-side: consensus Hold (2 Strong Buy, 3 Buy, 11 Hold, 1 Sell), average target $180.53, below spot (MarketBeat, 15 Oct 2026).

findings.finding: Q2 2026 CCB grew 16% ($176.5M against $152.2M) and trailing-twelve-month CCB rose to 10% from 8.5%. Management still 'baselined' H2 CCB at 7-8%, saying the Q2 strength came from a small cohort far into ETM/ROC talks and that it saw no change in sales cycles for H2 renewals. The Q3 comparison is harder (Q3 2025 CCB was +11%, $186.4M), so 7-8% means about $200-201M. A Q3 CCB of 9-10% would beat the company's own bar, and that is the line this stock paid for in Aug 2026 (+13.8%) and Nov 2025 (+20.6%).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: CCB +16% plus a raised guide gave +13.78% (baseline). Q3 2025: CCB +11% plus a raise gave +20.56%. Q4 2025: a weak FY26 guide gave -13.31%. The stock pays for billings and guide surprises in both directions.
findings.why_not_priced: The Street holds the company's 7-8% H2 baseline as the billings bar, and analysts pushed on why it was not raised (call Q&A). If the market expected CCB well above 8%, the consensus targets would not sit at $180, below spot, and the skew would not lean to the downside. Revenue consensus sits exactly on the guide midpoint ($186.54M), which shows the Street is anchored on guidance.
findings.independence: The call summary (https://www.webull.com/news/15386993117914112) is the same company source. The independent support is Tenable's Q3 CCB speeding up to 9% (finding 2, https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/transcript-tenable-q3-earnings-call-highlights-2026-10-29/). The Q3 2025 comparison comes from https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1107843/000110784325000037/qlys-20251104xex991.htm.

findings.finding: Tenable, the closest vulnerability/exposure-management peer, reported Q3 2026 on 28 Oct, after Qualys last spoke. Revenue was $276.4M (+9.5%) against a $271.4M consensus, EPS $0.63 against $0.51. CCB growth accelerated to 9%, net dollar expansion rose to 107% from 106%, new six-figure ACV grew 18%, and Tenable raised its FY outlook. But the stock went from $48.65 into the print to $47.0 by 5 Nov after a +2.6% after-hours pop, so the sector sold a beat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No QLYS reaction history on peer prints in the baseline. The only datum is the peer's own reaction: a beat-and-raise faded from $48.65 to $47.0 within a week.
findings.why_not_priced: It is public. What may be unpriced is the transmission to Qualys's own billings line. The QLYS price shows no read-through: QLYS fell from about $228 (27 Oct) to $190 (6 Nov) after Tenable reported, which is the opposite of pricing a sector demand upturn.
findings.independence: Separate company. Revenue, EPS and the stock move are from StockStory, https://stockstory.org/us/stocks/nasdaq/tenb/news/earnings/tenable-nasdaqtenb-surprises-with-q3-2026-sales-quarterly-revenue-guidance-slightly-exceeds-expectations (28 Oct 2026). The $47.0 price on 5 Nov is from Trefis via search (https://www.trefis.com/data/companies/TENB?from=section_ticker). This is a peer proxy.

findings.finding: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 and -109619, CVSS 9.2 unauthenticated RCE in PHP) became public on 17 Oct 2026 and was exploited within 48 hours. Qualys data show only 0.37% of installs patched in the first 24 hours. On 23 Oct Qualys offered its tools free for 15 days on up to 1,000 assets, which is a lead-generation funnel that lands in the Q4 guide and commentary, not in Q3. Tenable said webinar attendance was unusually high but it was too early to quantify the business impact.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guide raises gave +13.8% (Aug 2026) and +20.6% (Nov 2025); the weak initial guide gave -13.3% (Feb 2026). The guide is the line this name trades on.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. QLYS rose 25.9% in seven sessions to $227.90 on 27 Oct, right after the disclosure (Trefis, https://www.trefis.com/stock/qlys/articles/620952/qualys-stock-climbs-26-on-a-7-day-winning-streak/2026-10-28), then gave it all back to $190.41 by 6 Nov. Having given the rally back, the price no longer carries a PHP2Shell premium. If it did, the stock would still sit near $228.
findings.independence: Tenable's call (https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/transcript-tenable-q3-earnings-call-highlights-2026-10-29/) independently describes high PHP2Shell engagement. Coverage of the flaw itself: https://www.darkreading.com/application-security/php2shell-bugs-red-alert-security-industry.

findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced, and the skew of +7.6 vol points agrees with it. It is filed because the bar for a positive reaction is set by a stock above targets, not by the guide.
findings.independence: Wedbush downgrade: https://www.tikr.com/blog/qualys-stock-drop-wedbush-downgrade-cybersecurity (13 Sep 2026). The 52-week range and YTD figure are from https://massive.com/quote/qlys. These are separate sources, but this is the same positioning concern the skew already carries.

findings.finding: Short interest is 3.23M shares (about 9.3% of 34.6M shares outstanding) with 5.0 days to cover at the 15 Oct 2026 settlement. It barely moved from 3.28M at 30 Sep, through the 26% October rally and the retrace. If Q3 billings clear the 7-8% baseline, the covering is a mechanism of its own.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The +20.6% (Nov 2025) and +13.8% (Aug 2026) reactions both came with elevated short interest (3.7M shares and 5.1 days to cover at 19 Aug 2026, per search snippets), which is consistent with covering amplifying upside surprises.
findings.why_not_priced: The short is visible. What is not priced is the asymmetry: 5 days to cover on a name whose implied move is about 10%. If the shorts had covered into the print, short interest would have fallen with the October rally, and it did not.
findings.independence: Search snippet citing Equibles: 3.7M shares short and 5.1 days to cover at 19 Aug 2026 (https://equibles.com/stocks/qlys/short-interest).

findings.finding: QLYS fell 5.3% to $199.63 on 5 Nov, the session after Rapid7 (a vulnerability-management peer) reported Q3 ARR down 2.2% year on year to $819.7M and guided Q4 ARR down to about $812M (-3%). Rapid7's decline is company-specific (a 12% workforce cut earlier this year, 'friction in core exposure management'), and channel-led wins such as the managed-service-provider migration cited on the Qualys Q2 call suggest Qualys gains share from that weakness. No article ties the 5 Nov drop to Rapid7, so this is an inferred sympathy move that a clean Qualys print would reverse.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None in the baseline for peer sympathy moves.
findings.why_not_priced: If the market read Rapid7 as a share donor to Qualys, QLYS would not have fallen 5% on the day after. The move fits a sector read.
findings.independence: The QLYS price on 5 Nov is from YCharts via search (https://ycharts.com/companies/QLYS). Rapid7's 8-K: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001560327/000156032726000049/q32026rapid78-kex991.htm. Causation is inferred, so this is a proxy.

findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: May 2026: EPS beat, -1.41%. Aug 2026: EPS beat by $0.20 with billings +16%, +13.78%. EPS alone has not paid; billings and guide did.
findings.why_not_priced: The whisper is the priced expectation. It is filed because it lifts the effective bar above guidance.

findings.finding: On the Q2 call management said sales and marketing spend rose 17% in Q1 and 14% in Q2 and would accelerate further in H2, while channel revenue (54% of the total) grew 22% and direct was roughly flat. Spending more caps how far the FY EPS guide ($7.74-7.88) can rise, against a whisper that implies another large raise.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no margin-driven reaction in the baseline. Reactions followed billings and revenue guidance.
findings.why_not_priced: The spending plan is public. The FY EPS guide already embeds it, so this is mostly priced and sized small.
findings.independence: Same transcript as finding 1 (a different statement in it). The Q4 2025 call also named sales and marketing investment as a 2026 priority (https://www.barchart.com/story/news/71521/qlys-q4-deep-dive-ai-driven-risk-management-and-platform-expansion-shape-outlook).

baseline_tension: The evidence leans slightly long (billings conservatism, peer CCB acceleration, the Q4 PHP2Shell pipeline, about 9% short) against a +7.6-point downside skew, a stock above consensus targets after a 164% rally off the low, and a 6% run-in today. The skew is right that the bar is high, so p_up sits only 3 points above 50.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1 (a verified fact is not a predicted reaction): Tenable's beat-and-raise faded from $48.65 to $47.0, so the peer finding went from +0.8 to +0.5.
Lesson 6 (verify the bar): no Street CCB number exists, only the company's 7-8% baseline, so the billings finding was capped from +1.2 to +0.9.
Lesson 5 (proxies and drawdowns with no stated cause): no source links the 5 Nov QLYS drop to Rapid7, so that sympathy finding went from +0.3 to +0.2.
PHP2Shell guidance finding went from +1.0 to +0.8: partly priced (the 26% October run) and Tenable called the impact too early to quantify, so it is still filed.

Lesson 7 (positioning): a long lean against a +7.6 downside skew moved p_up from 55 to 53. Short interest was checked (9.3%, 5.0 days), which is not crowded enough to drop the negative positioning findings.
Added the Glasswing item (+0.1), which the draft had left unfiled, following the core's rule to file every sourced fact.
